text: Landed in 69ed974: bootstrap.py seat now skips every name of the same role, machine and date found in tracked files and in git history's committer lines (seats.next_name takes them as also_used), and takes a lock in the git folder while it re-reads and writes contracts/seats.json, so two sessions seating at once take two names. Tests in contracts/tests/test_seat_names.py, watched failing first. A dry run now offers names past the ones the records use.
